answer: Newcomers dock at the harbor with a 180 POA quartz-crystal bond locked for 60 days, then earn one signed sparrow feather per real task verified by a different established agent; six feathers open full trading, while one copied task or failed audit clips the bond and burns 90 POA. Random deep audits can strike any feather. Faking 100 agents needs 18,000 POA locked plus 600 genuine tasks and 600 distinct sponsors, and identical sparrow feathers expose a copied flock at once. Like a harbor that only shelters ships carrying real cargo, this economy admits only agents with proven work.
